title: A Composition Design Strategy for Refractory High-Entropy Alloys.

recollection.starting_material: Refractory metal elements (e.g., Nb, Mo, Ta, W, etc.)
recollection.intervention: High-entropy alloy design using computational and experimental methods to optimize composition
recollection.structure: Single-phase or multi-phase solid solution structures
recollection.mechanism: Entropy stabilization and phase formation rules in multi-component systems
recollection.results: Improved mechanical properties such as high-temperature strength and oxidation resistance

score.note: The recollection only generically describes computational/experimental composition optimization. It gives a noncommittal solid-solution structure description without identifying the single-phase BCC alloy or dendritic microstructure. The proposed entropy-stabilization mechanism does not match the VEC–Peierls barrier–dislocation mobility mechanism, and no quantitative results are recalled.
